tasks.InitialDepth: The initial depth of the water on Monday is given as 17 feet.
tasks.TuesdayDepthCalculation: Calculate the depth of the water on Tuesday by adding 7 feet to the initial depth on Monday.
tasks.WednesdayDepthCalculation: Calculate the depth of the water on Wednesday, which is two thirds of what it was on Tuesday.

answer: The depth of the water on Wednesday is 14 feet.
